title: Grateful Dead Live at Assembly Hall - University Of Illinois on 1973-02-22

ai_review.summary: A crystal‑clear 1973 soundboard captures a ferocious Playing in the Band, early‑era They Love Each Other and a blistering Me & My Uncle.
ai_review.review: The Elliot soundboard source delivers tremendous clarity—every instrument is distinct and even Donna’s backing vocals shine. Musically the show shines on the uptempo, aggressive Playing in the Band, an early golden version of They Love Each Other, a super‑fast Me & My Uncle and a twin‑guitar weave on Eyes of the World, while occasional glitches (Dark Star) and a weak Wave That Flag keep it from perfection.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (average 4.4), strong praise for both performance and sound quality, with only minor technical glitches noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very clear mix; instruments and vocals are well separated. Minor issues: a glitch at ~4:42 in Dark Star, a slight cut in the first verse of Goin' Down the Road, and equipment problems on Wave That Flag.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds nicely with a warm Promised Land and golden early They Love Each Other, while the second set ramps up energy through an aggressive Playing in the Band, fiery Me & My Uncle and soaring Eyes of the World. A few average moments keep the pacing solid overall.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Aggressive ‘73 Strat tone on Deal, leading the twin‑guitar attack on Eyes of the World and driving the high‑octane Playing in the Band.
band_member_comments.Bob: Delivers a flawless El Paso, a scorching solo on Me & My Uncle, and solid rhythm throughout.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is praised as ‘great Billy,’ providing a tight backbone with minimal Donnaskreech trademark.
